name: sosein-staging
description: Recall memories and collaborate with Sosein's staging artifacts from Codex through the staging Sosein MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Recall memories and collaborate in Sosein Staging
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Sosein Staging through OAuth-backed MCP. Recall relevant memories with citations, search and read exact blocks or complete sections, observe artifact changes, create documents, notes, or records privately or in a workspace, edit text, blocks, and objects, append to sections, and collaborate through reviews using access delegated from the signed-in user.
